{{Quote|We were out of bacta, low on food, and running out of ammunition. Enemy troops, though, we had big time!|[[Jace Dallin]]|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 39">[[Star Wars (1998) 39|''Star Wars'' (1998) 39]]</ref>}}
The '''Fourth Battle of Qotile''' was a battle of the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace War]], the fourth of five battles fought on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Troiken/Legends|Troiken]]. Although the [[Stark Commercial Combine|Stark Combine]] had decided on maintaining a siege of [[Mount Avos]], the escape of several [[Senator/Legends|senators]] and a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and the discovery of a side entrance to the Avos mine, convinced [[Iaco Stark/Legends|Iaco Stark]] to attack. The forces of [[Outland Regions Security Force/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin's paramilitary]] were out of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] and low on both food and ammunition, yet thanks to the help of the native [[Xexto/Legends|Xexto]] [[Billibango]] (who had an intimate knowledge of the mine's structure) the forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] were able to repulse the invaders.

The Republic victory allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to contact the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] on Coruscant and establish a plan for a [[Fifth Battle of Qotile|final battle]], while the co-directors of the Combine nearly killed Stark for his failure to once again defeat the Republic military.
